description: Defines the class 'pdcp_tx_metrics' which manages transmission metrics for PDCP layer, including adding metrics, retrieving, resetting, and handling latency measurements.

classes.name: pdcp_tx_metrics
classes.description: Class for collecting and managing PDCP transmission metrics, including SDUs, PDUs, latency, and dropped data.

methods.name: pdcp_tx_metrics
methods.description: Constructor to initialize metrics with enabled/disabled state.

methods.name: is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if metrics collection is enabled.

methods.name: add_sdus
methods.description: Adds SDUs and their byte size to metrics.

methods.name: add_pdus
methods.description: Adds PDUs and their byte size to metrics.

methods.name: get_metrics
methods.description: Retrieves current metrics, asserting if disabled.

methods.name: get_metrics_and_reset
methods.description: Retrieves metrics and resets counters, asserting if disabled.

methods.name: add_pdu_latency_ns
methods.description: Records PDU latency in nanoseconds and updates histogram and min/max latency.

methods.name: reset_metrics
methods.description: Resets all metrics except the counter, asserting if disabled.
